verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents an official Command-Line Interface on a first-party docs page. It covers scripted installation, license registration, password setting, silent removal and starting sessions, explicitly for automation and integration with other systems. It is mainly an installer and launcher parameter interface aimed at IT deployment rather than a rich agent-oriented CLI. Missing for 10: evidence of structured or machine-readable output and broader account or session management from the CLI, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
